s03DFCC.name: Bowser room palette and lightning flash
summary: Called from Bowser's INIT/main (JSL at BowserFight). Appends an 8-color CGRAM upload record (start color 0) to the palette buffer at [$0681].
Color 0 (backdrop) flashes with thunder: a random delay in [$1FFC] counts down, then [$1FFB] steps through DATA_00B5DE colors and sound $18 plays.
Colors 1-7 come from a 14-byte row of DATA_00B69E selected by [$1429]; [$190D] non-zero (hedged: no lightning) keeps the backdrop color [$0701].

s03E400.name: Ending music block header (disassembled as code)
summary: Not code: these bytes are the start of the SPC700 music bank 3 block uploaded by UploadMusicBank3 ($03E400). Disassembler produced DEC/RTS.

s03E403.name: Ending music bank 3 data (SPC700)
summary: Music sequence data for the ending, uploaded to the SPC700 as one block starting at $03E400. Not 65816 data.

lines.03DFDF: X = [$1FFB] (lightning flash step, 0 = no flash running)
lines.03DFE7: / [$190D] (probably disables lightning) = 0: go check for a new flash
lines.03DFF8: / Count down [$1FFC] (delay to next flash); not zero: no new flash
lines.03DFFB: Read a byte from ROM $04F708 as a pseudo-random number
lines.03E02A: } X = [$1FFB] * 2: word index into the flash color table
lines.03E03D: / X = row offset (row * $0E) into the palette table
lines.03E042: Copy a palette byte from DATA_00B69E[X]...
lines.03E057: Store the new palette buffer index
lines.03E400: Unreferenced as code: the start of the ending music block header (see UploadMusicBank3)
lines.03E402: Header continues: length probably $19C6, SPC address probably $1360
